latest_release.name: Deploy 2026-11-12 23:16 UTC
latest_release.body:
## Changes
- #4526 feat(dict): expand industrial maintenance skill vocabulary
- #4524 refactor: remove dead code (bakeoff in prod binary, anonymous-only MCP server, trivial web type copies)
- #4525 refactor(assistant): share the small helpers of the assistant tools
- #4521 fix(web): improve interface typography and reduce decorative motion
- #4523 fix(web): prevent profile tier badge overlap
- #4519 fix(design-system): inset the chevron on every native select
- #4522 chore(openspec): archive mcp-cli-session-hints and sync its spec
- #4520 feat(mcp): tell a session the freehire CLI opened that the CLI is on its shell
- #4518 fix(web): pick the salaries currency from a select, not a wall of chips
- #4509 feat(mcp): let a person add a CV as text and see what setup is missing
- #4516 refactor(api): make the contract match the wire for mentors, employers and companies
- #4515 refactor(api): make the contract match the wire for account, tracking, mail and reports
- #4514 refactor(api): make the contract match the wire for billing, stats and buddies

## How it was verified
- CI passed on the target revision across CI, Contract, CodeQL, Container smoke and gitleaks. Batch has no schema migrations, search settings changes or new workers.
- Running application revision confirmed as b9cb6cef2ba655c4f5e8cabb4b8bf35fbcf19d29; background ingestion and deployed derivation binary updated.
- Public smoke: 15/15 expected responses, including job search, facets, catalog, home, jobs, companies and pricing; authenticated account endpoint correctly returned 401 anonymously.
- Dictionary browser: SAP PM, TPM and ISO/IEC 17025 rendered; no captured console errors or failed resources. Skill filters accepted tpm, rcm, apm, oee and sap-pm without ignored parameters.
- Measured comparison 16 minutes after deployment: verdict OK; API p95 0.097 -> 0.168 seconds; API 5xx share 0 -> 0, public 5xx rate 0 -> 0; no newly failed services, no new incident since deployment.
- Not yet activated for existing postings: new industrial skill counts remain 0 pending a full serialized derivation and search rebuild after an existing long-running pass. Dictionary/catalog deployment is verified; full data activation is tracked separately and is not claimed complete.
- Not exercised as signed-in journeys: profile tier badge layout, salary currency selection, CV text onboarding and CLI session hints. These changes passed CI; public page smoke passed.
